title: Saying How Sure You Are
goal: Place each claim on the scale from certain to doubtful.

items: I can say I am sure with *no cabe duda de que* and *no dudo que*.
I can say I doubt something with *dudo que* and *no es seguro que*.
I can choose how sure to sound for each claim.
